newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-6 month T-bill yields stay unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-6 month T-bill yields stay unchanged.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.25 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 11, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 10.678 million UAG 7.657 million UAG
Actual amount raised 9.344 million UAG 6.700 million UAG
Ukraine's central bank sold 106,780 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 62,313 were competitive and 44,467 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for September 13.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 59.50 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 11, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 25.412 million UAG 120.3 thousand UAG
Actual amount raised 19.567 million UAG 92.8 thousand UAG
The central bank sold 254,120 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 246,754 were competitive and 7,366 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for September 13.
